name: Phichit Running Challenge 2026
short_description: Phichit Running Challenge 2026 is on Sunday 22 November 2026 at Wang Krot Old Market in Kha Mang, Phichit, over 42.2 km, 21.1 km, 10.5 km and 5 km.
ai_summary: Phichit Running Challenge 2026 starts and finishes at Wang Krot Old Market in Kha Mang, Mueang Phichit District, on a flat, out-and-back road course, according to its World's Marathons entry page. The marathon starts at 03:00 with a 7-hour cut-off and the half marathon at 05:00 with a 4-hour cut-off. The course passes through the historic Wang Krot riverside and railway area.

faqs.question: What are the start times and cut-offs at Phichit Running Challenge 2026?
faqs.answer: The marathon starts at 03:00 (7-hour cut-off), the half marathon at 05:00 (4 hours), the 10.5 km at 05:30 (3 hours) and the 5 km at 06:00 (2 hours). The marathon and half marathon are open to runners aged 18 and over.

faqs.question: Where is race-pack pickup for Phichit Running Challenge 2026?
faqs.answer: Race packs are collected on Saturday 21 November 2026 from 10:00 to 20:00 at Wang Krot Old Market in Phichit. On World's Marathons, entries cost EUR 13 to EUR 26 and include a medal, event shirt, finisher shirt and timing chip.
